scope: Windows current-user local host control; separate from room protocol

discovery.protectedKey: base64 Windows DPAPI CurrentUser protected UTF-8 key

GET /api/v1/host-control/receipts/{reque.returns: sanitized committed/rejected/pending receipt or unknown; current local authority required; pending HTTP 503, rejected HTTP 404 or 409

semantics.sameRequestId: returns first terminal result; changed password is not applied; changed operation, account or create role conflicts; pending intent recovers before replay
semantics.passwordReset: atomic password hash replacement and target session revocation, including target KP sessions
semantics.creation: identity and active room member; role defaults to player; committed only after both stores are ready
semantics.deletion: disable identity, revoke all sessions, deactivate member and increment authorizationEpoch; preserve memberId and historical references; reserve deleted accountId
semantics.lastKpProtection: LAST_KP_REQUIRED when deletion leaves no active, login-capable KP
semantics.recovery: durable identity intent blocks target login until room change and final identity receipt complete; startup and request retry finish pending work

client.input: stdin UTF-8 JSON, at most 16384 bytes: operation list, receipt with requestId, or exact account mutation DTO
client.output: one safe JSON object on stdout; exit 0 success or unknown, exit 2 error/rejected/pending
client.discovery: match canonical dataDirectory then verify live instanceId/pid/dataDirectory; no proxies or redirects; HOST_NOT_RUNNING if no live match, HOST_CONTROL_INSTANCE_AMBIGUOUS if multiple
